create_best_response: create a BestResponse instance to compute the best response value for a mean-field game with a given distribution
eval_state_best_response: eval the optimal value of a game state using the BestResponse backward pass algorithm
evaluate_best_response: evaluate the best response value across all root states of a mean-field game
value_best_response: retrieve the value of a game state or state-action pair from the BestResponse cache
test_best_response_class: test the BestResponse class that recursively computes optimal policy values given a fixed state distribution
